evidence: The assigned workbook row requires every dimension prompt to describe this app accurately and consistently. The app name, all seven account identities/roles/password, six screens and two clock anchors agree between instruction.md:5,15, app_context.md:3-25 and hireops_rules.md:23-68. All seven trusted P0 data families in scored/functional/prompt.md:25 were compared field-by-field to the public seed (mapping person IDs to names): every transcribed field and count matched. No sibling product/account/data-shape residue was found. Two related stale workflow clauses remain: (1) task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:11 says "Earlier gates may have added a unique requisition and committed offer"; the current task/tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md:5 instead requires a zero-extra PENDING offer and says "do not approve, revise or rescind", and constraints/judge.toml:24-28 explicitly requires that it remain PENDING and says approval receives scored credit. (2) constraints/prompt.md:7 still says "Use ordinary UI interactions for requisition creation, offer creation and approval" despite approval being outside that gate. These are bounded prompt-consistency defects, not a demonstrated score distortion: the same functional paragraph forbids using the gate records as controls and requires dedicated setup, and the constraint criterion clearly defines the pending state. Relevant SHA256 values verified against the frozen manifest: functional/prompt.md=700ce0cd545a21a18727ca13ef66a9bb250db424f951fefa6c4b64a987e56419; constraints/prompt.md=119063977daf210e51d581b0011c5e1edefc9e38e78e876a0ead84837802618f; constraints/judge.toml=16e25fdcd5c40bc6c2e26e5bf3c21d912db4cf72d26aa542a59b146031e425f7. All other cited task prompts/context/public rules/seed, workbook, skill/references, template prompts/context and review policy hashes matched. Source review only; no configured judge result is claimed or required to establish these textual inconsistencies.
counterexample: Conforming alternative: an app correctly creates a PENDING offer, the Constraints reviewer follows its criterion and leaves it PENDING, and there is no gate-created committed offer when Functional begins; the Functional setup description is then inaccurate. Plausible weak app: creation/shared storage works while approvals fail; this app is supposed to pass the minimal Constraints gate and lose approval credit in Functional, but a judge treating the residual "and approval" clause as an instruction could demand the wrong action at the gate. The explicit criterion mitigates this ambiguity, so no observed or inevitable misgrade is asserted.
suggested_fix: In a new candidate, describe the earlier gate offer as PENDING in the Functional prompt and remove "and approval" from the Constraints gate UI-interaction sentence; retain the existing scoring scope and harness.
